correctness.rationale: The 90 labelled row/column-sum-two binary 4x4 matrices were independently enumerated from all four-row pairs. For degrees r=0..4 independent evaluation of all <=r parity characters yielded numerical ranks (1,10,39,75,90); the quadratic 90x90 matrix H2H2^T had eigenvalues (160^9,256^9,320^4,384^12,512^4,650^1) and 51 zeros, matching the exact source characteristic polynomial. The supplied verify_krawtchouk.py and independently constructed verify_direct.py were read and implement exact integer characteristic polynomials and independent prime-modular rank lower bounds. The Krawtchouk kernel 137-34d+2d^2 follows by counting character intersections; the invertible triangular character-to-squarefree-monomial map proves Hilbert increments (1,9,29,36,15), sharp degree four and normalization/condition numbers. This is a finite exact theorem with reproducible complete enumeration, not an infinite extrapolation.
